set.body:
Implement the next neurothresh thresholding slice in idiomatic Scala 3.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a shared HierScan API that runs a whole-mask octree descent over a NeuroVol[Double] statistic map with optional mask/prior volumes.
- Reuse MaskedField, PriorWeights, Octree, ScoreSet, NullDraw, and Westfall-Young adjustment instead of introducing a parallel thresholding stack.
- Return a typed result with significant regions, node-level test records, a reject mask, and parameter provenance.
- Keep parcel seeds, TFCE, and richer null factories out of this slice.
- Add shared MUnit coverage with deterministic null draws and verify both thresholdJVM/test and thresholdJS/test.
set.title: Threshold: HierScan whole-mask MVP
